# mapSpainHist

**English** ·
[Castellano](https://github.com/pauvallprat/mapSpainHist/blob/main/README.es.md)
·
[Català](https://github.com/pauvallprat/mapSpainHist/blob/main/README.ca.md)

**mapSpainHist** is an R package with the **municipal boundaries of
Spain for each population census between 1900 and 2001** (1900, 1910,
1920, 1930, 1940, 1950, 1960, 1970, 1981, 1991 and 2001) and the
**higher-level territorial units** built from these municipalities:
provinces, judicial districts and historical electoral districts. It
also includes the **basic census figures** of every municipality between
1842 and 2011.

All maps come from a single partition of the territory, so they **have
no gaps or overlaps** and can be aggregated without leaving holes
between units.

> **Important warning.** The shape of most historical municipalities is
> an **approximate reconstruction**. The maps are especially useful to
> **represent municipal data graphically**, but they must be used **with
> caution** when geographic variables such as **area** or **distances**
> matter. See the
> [methodology](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/en/methodology.html).

## Installation

``` r

# Development version, from GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("pauvallprat/mapSpainHist")
```

The geometries are downloaded from
[Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23663208) the first time they
are used (about 6.5 MB) and stored in a local cache; afterwards they are
read directly from disk.

## Usage

``` r

library(mapSpainHist)

# Municipalities of the 1930 census, with census figures
m1930 <- esp_get_munic_hist(1930)

# Canary Islands next to the Peninsula, as in the `mapSpain` package, with their box
m1930 <- esp_get_munic_hist(1930, moveCAN = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(m1930) + geom_sf() + geom_sf(data = mapSpain::esp_get_can_box())

# Higher-level units
esp_get_prov_hist(1930)   # provinces (available for every census)
esp_get_pj_hist(1910)     # judicial districts (1900-1930)
esp_get_circ_hist(1920)   # districts for the Cortes of the Restoration
esp_get_circ_hist(1933)   # constituencies of the Second Republic (also 1931 and 1936)

# Tables
head(censos)    # census figures of every municipality, 1842-2011
head(unitats)   # higher-level unit of every municipality
```

| Function | Content | Years |
|----|----|----|
| [`esp_get_munic_hist()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/esp_get_munic_hist.md) | Municipalities | 1900, 1910, 1920, 1930, 1940, 1950, 1960, 1970, 1981, 1991, 2001 |
| [`esp_get_prov_hist()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/esp_get_prov_hist.md) | Provinces | the same censuses |
| [`esp_get_pj_hist()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/esp_get_pj_hist.md) | Judicial districts | 1900, 1910, 1920, 1930 |
| [`esp_get_circ_hist()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/esp_get_circ_hist.md) | Districts for the Cortes during the Restoration (1920) and constituencies of the Second Republic | 1920, 1931, 1933, 1936 |

## Problems and suggestions

If you find an error in the maps or the data, or have a suggestion, use
the [contact
form](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/en/contact.html),
write to <pau.vall@ub.edu> or [open an
issue](https://github.com/pauvallprat/mapSpainHist/issues/new/choose) on
GitHub.

## How to cite

If you use the package and/or its data, please cite them. You can get
the reference with:

``` r

citation("mapSpainHist")
```

- Vall Prat, P. (2026). *Historical municipal boundaries of Spain,
  1900-2001* \[Data set\]. Zenodo.
  <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23663208>

## Licenses

- **R package** (code and the bundled `censos` and `unitats` tables):
  [MIT](https://github.com/pauvallprat/mapSpainHist/blob/main/LICENSE.md)
  license.
- **Zenodo data deposit** (geometries, census tables and GeoPackage):
  [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY
  4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The reference municipal boundaries derive from SIANE (© Instituto
Geográfico Nacional, CC BY 4.0), downloaded for the earliest year
available in the `mapSpain` package; census figures come from the
population censuses of the INE; municipal changes from the document by
the Ministerio de Administraciones Públicas [*Variaciones de los
municipios de España desde
1842*](https://www.hacienda.gob.es/SGT/catalogo_sefp/100_variaciones-internet.pdf).
See the methodology for details.

# Package index

## Maps

- [`esp_get_munic_hist()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/esp_get_munic_hist.md)
  : Historical municipalities of Spain for a census year
- [`esp_get_prov_hist()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/esp_get_prov_hist.md)
  : Historical provinces of Spain for a census year
- [`esp_get_pj_hist()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/esp_get_pj_hist.md)
  : Historical judicial districts (partidos judiciales) of Spain
- [`esp_get_circ_hist()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/esp_get_circ_hist.md)
  : Historical electoral districts of Spain

## Data

- [`censos`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/censos.md)
  : Census figures of Spanish municipalities, 1842-2011
- [`unitats`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/unitats.md)
  : Municipalities of each historical higher-level unit

## Utilities

- [`mhist_census_years()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/mhist_census_years.md)
  : Census editions available
- [`mhist_cache_dir()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/mhist_cache_dir.md)
  [`mhist_set_cache_dir()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/mhist_cache_dir.md)
  : Cache directory of mapSpainHist
- [`mhist_clear_cache()`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/mhist_clear_cache.md)
  : Clear the cache of mapSpainHist

## Package

- [`mapSpainHist`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/mapSpainHist-package.md)
  [`mapSpainHist-package`](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/reference/mapSpainHist-package.md)
  : mapSpainHist: Historical Municipal Boundaries of Spain (1900-2001)

# Articles

### English

- [Introduction to
  mapSpainHist](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/en/introduction.md):

  First steps: municipal maps of a census, census figures and changes
  over time.

- [Higher-level units and data
  aggregation](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/en/units.md):

  Historical provinces, judicial districts and electoral districts, and
  how to aggregate municipal data to them.

- [Guide to functions and
  data](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/en/functions.md):

  Overview of all the functions, arguments and tables of the package.

- [Methodology, sources and
  warnings](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/en/methodology.md):

  How the maps were built, where the data come from and what their
  limitations are.

- [Problems and
  suggestions](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/en/contact.md):

  How to report errors or make suggestions about the maps and the data.

### Castellano

- [Introducción a
  mapSpainHist](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/es/introduccion.md):

  Primeros pasos: mapas municipales de un censo, datos de los censos y
  cambios a lo largo del tiempo.

- [Unidades superiores y agregación de
  datos](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/es/unidades.md):

  Provincias, partidos judiciales y distritos electorales históricos, y
  cómo agregar en ellos datos municipales.

- [Guía de funciones y
  datos](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/es/funciones.md):

  Descripción en castellano de todas las funciones, argumentos y tablas
  del paquete.

- [Metodología, fuentes y
  advertencias](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/es/metodologia.md):

  Cómo se han construido los mapas, de dónde proceden los datos y qué
  limitaciones tienen.

- [Problemas y
  sugerencias](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/es/contacto.md):

  Cómo notificar errores o hacer sugerencias sobre los mapas y los
  datos.

### Català

- [Introducció a
  mapSpainHist](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/ca/introduccio.md):

  Primers passos: mapes municipals d’un cens, dades dels censos i canvis
  al llarg del temps.

- [Unitats superiors i agregació de
  dades](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/ca/unitats.md):

  Províncies, partits judicials i districtes electorals històrics, i com
  agregar-hi dades municipals.

- [Guia de funcions i
  dades](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/ca/funcions.md):

  Descripció en català de totes les funcions, arguments i taules del
  paquet.

- [Metodologia, fonts i
  advertiments](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/ca/metodologia.md):

  Com s’han construït els mapes, d’on provenen les dades i quines
  limitacions tenen.

- [Problemes i
  suggeriments](https://pauvallprat.github.io/mapSpainHist/articles/ca/contacte.md):

  Com notificar errors o fer suggeriments sobre els mapes i les dades.
